theme_central: The account of the People of the Ditch, burned alive for their faith in Allah alone — the most extreme persecution only reveals the Lord's ultimate rigor and mercy.
sources_note: Narrative of Ashab al-Ukhdud (People of the Ditch) widely taught and undisputed; classical 5-movement structure.

branches.title: Cosmic oath
branches.resume: Oath by the sky with its constellations, the promised Day, witness and witnessed.

children.t: Oath by the sky with its constellations, the promised Day

branches.title: The People of the Ditch
branches.resume: Cursed be the people of the fueled ditch, sitting to watch the torment of the believers for their faith alone.

children.t: The People of the Ditch burn believers for their faith in Allah alone

branches.title: Contrasting fate
branches.resume: Punishment of Gehenna for the unrepentant persecutors; Paradise for those who believed and did good.

children.t: Gehenna for the persecutors, Paradise for the believers

branches.title: Allah's rigor and love
branches.resume: The rigor of your Lord who creates and recreates; the Forgiving, the Loving, Master of the glorious Throne.

children.t: Allah's rigor and mercy, Master of the glorious Throne

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Account of the armies of Pharaoh and Thamud; glorious Qur'an on a Preserved Tablet.

children.t: Account of Pharaoh and Thamud, the Qur'an preserved on the Guarded Tablet
